# Model compatibility

The SiMa.ai compilation toolchain imports **ONNX** models and prepares operators for the Machine Learning Accelerator (MLA). Use this page to check operator support before you prepare a model for Modalix.

## Supported operators

Search the table to check MLA compiler support by operator and precision scheme. **INT8** runs on the MLA. **BF16** is available on Modalix (developer preview). **5D** marks operators that accept 5D (N, D, H, W, C) tensors. **Opset** is the ONNX opset version. Search matches constraint text as well as operator names, and each operator links to its reference on onnx.ai.

## Constraints

These operators are supported with the limits below. Operators not listed here have no additional constraints. Where a constraint names an ONNX attribute, set it accordingly when you export the model.

- **Add** — Same shape, or exactly one input is a scalar, or both inputs are broadcastable
- **ArgMax** — Output is int32 (HW has no int64)<br />axis = channel axis only (SW)
- **AveragePool** — count_include_pad = 1 (HW)<br />kernel_shape: If global pool, no size limit; otherwise size < 128. (HW. Workaround by SW)<br />dilations = 1 for newer opset (HW)
- **BatchNormalization** — training_mode = 0 (SW)
- **Concat** — Not on batch axis
- **Conv** — dilation = [1, 63] (HW)<br />strides = [1, 31] (HW)
- **ConvTranspose** — dilations == 1 (HW)<br />group = 1 (HW) or depthwise (SW)<br />stride =  [1, 2, 4, 8, 16] non-depthwise; [1, 2] depthwise (SW)
- **Cos** — INT8 activation only. A bfloat16 activation request inserts casts and executes Cos as an INT8 lookup-table UDF.
- **CumSum** — reverse = 0 (SW)<br />Size <= 257 on summation axis. (SW)<br />Must have exactly one summation axis. (SW)<br />Axis must be a constant. (HW)
- **Div** — Same shape, or exactly one input is a scalar, or both inputs are broadcastable
- **Einsum** — Must have two input tensors. (SW)<br />Supports any equation where each variable is used in at least two tensors and at most once in each tensor.  An example violating the first condition is jk,k->k (j is not used in at least two tensors).  An example violating the second condition is jk,kk->j (k is used twice in one tensor). (SW)
- **Expand** — Shape must be compile-time constant and broadcast-compatible. Batch dimension cannot be broadcast or changed. (SW)
- **Flatten** — axis = 1 so the batch dimension is preserved. Input and output must be at least 2D. (SW)
- **Gather** — Indices must be a constant, and it must be 0D or 1D. (HW)
- **Gelu** — approximate = "none" (SW)
- **Gemm** — A and B must be rank-2. B must be a compile-time constant initializer; a runtime B input is unsupported and fails before backend partitioning. alpha and beta may be finite floating-point values. transB = 0 or 1 is supported. transA = 1 requires flexible_batch_size=False because the leading dimension of A is K rather than batch. Optional constant C supports scalar, [N], [1,N], or [M,N]; constant [M,1] is unsupported. A runtime C remains entirely on MLA only for [1,N], [M,1], or [M,N]; runtime scalar or [N] C uses APU fallback.
- **GlobalLpPool** — p = 2. Static input shape. Input rank = 3, 4, or 5. (SW)
- **GridSample** — Limited kernel for RaftStereo: sampling on W axis only. (SW)<br />mode = 'linear'<br />padding_mode != 'reflection'
- **InstanceNormalization** — Only for 4D and 5D tensors. (SW)
- **LayerNormalization** — stash_type = 10 (FLOAT16) not supported. (SW)
- **LogSoftmax** — Input and output must be at least 2D. (SW)
- **LpPool** — p = 2. dilation = 1. ceil_mode = 0. Static shapes. Kernel size < 128 in every spatial dimension unless the pool is global. (HW/SW)
- **MaxPool** — dilations = 1 (HW)<br />kernel_shape: If global pool, no size limit; otherwise size < 128. (HW)<br /><br />storage_order: No optional indices tensor output (SW)
- **Mean** — All inputs have the same shape and batch dimension. Fewer than 128 inputs. (SW/HW)
- **MeanVarianceNormalization** — INT8 activation only. A bfloat16 activation request inserts casts, but sqrt/rsqrt and some reduction paths still execute as INT8. Rank-5 (3D spatial) axis handling is layout-pattern dependent and is not generally supported; use rank 4 or lower for portable MLA support. The selected axes must produce nonzero variance because this ONNX operator has no epsilon attribute.
- **Mul** — Same shape, or exactly one input is a scalar, or both inputs are broadcastable
- **Pad** — mode: only ‘constant’ mode with value 0. (SW)<br />At most 2 dimensions may have a nonzero padding width. (SW)
- **Pow** — Input exponent is scalar constant 0.5, -0.5, 2, or 3. (SW)
- **PRelu** — 1D alpha. (SW)
- **ReduceL1** — Use ONNX opset <= 17 so axes are an attribute. If reducing a subset of spatial axes, each reduced extent must be < 128; reducing all spatial axes has no size limit. (SW/HW)
- **ReduceL2** — Expect following DIV to merge to L2 normalization.
- **ReduceLogSum** — Use ONNX opset <= 17 so axes are an attribute. If reducing a subset of spatial axes, each reduced extent must be < 128; reducing all spatial axes has no size limit. Reduced sums must be in the Log domain. (SW/HW)
- **ReduceLogSumExp** — Use ONNX opset <= 17 so axes are an attribute. If reducing a subset of spatial axes, each reduced extent must be < 128; reducing all spatial axes has no size limit. (SW/HW)
- **ReduceMean** — For 1D reduce, axis is spatial dimension only. (SW)<br />If all spatial axes, no size limit; otherwise, size in spatial axes less than 128. (HW)
- **ReduceMin** — Not supported yet. (SW)
- **ReduceSum** — For 1D reduce, axis is spatial dimension only. (SW)<br />If all spatial axes, no size limit; otherwise, size in spatial axes less than 128. (SW)
- **ReduceSumSquare** — Use ONNX opset <= 17 so axes are an attribute. If reducing a subset of spatial axes, each reduced extent must be < 128; reducing all spatial axes has no size limit. (SW/HW)
- **Reshape** — allowzero = 0 (SW)<br />Shape cannot be empty. (SW)
- **Resize** — mode = [nearest, linear] (HW/SW)<br />coordinate_transformation_mode= 'tf_crop_and_resize' not supported. (SW)<br />If method is 'linear', any scaling factor is supported. However,<br />for 8-bit integers any scaling more than 63 may lead to loss in accuracy. (HW)<br />If the method is 'nearest', then the scaling factor must be a power of two (HW), or the scaling factor must be an even integer (using the same factor in both dimensions) and the coordinate transformation mode must be half_pixel and the rounding mode must be floor. (SW)<br />Any other method or scaling factor is not supported.<br /><br />Single input only. (SW)
- **Sin** — INT8 activation only. A bfloat16 activation request inserts casts and executes Sin as an INT8 lookup-table UDF.
- **Slice** — Positive strides. (SW)
- **Softmax** — Over channel axis
- **Squeeze** — Axes input must be compile-time constant, may select only dimensions of size 1, and cannot remove the batch axis. Output must be at least 2D. (SW)
- **Sub** — Same shape, or exactly one input is a scalar, or both inputs are broadcastable
- **Sum** — All inputs have the same rank and batch dimension. Other dimensions are equal or 1. (SW)
- **Tile** — Repeats must be compile-time constant and the batch-axis repeat must be 1. Input and output must be at least 2D. (SW)
- **TopK** — K must be compile-time constant, 1 <= K < selected-axis size, and largest = 1. Input and outputs must be at least 2D. ONNX int64 indices are emitted as int32 because MLA has no int64. (SW/HW)
- **Transpose** — Not involving batch axis
- **Unsqueeze** — Axes input must be compile-time constant and cannot insert a new batch axis. Input and output must be at least 2D. (SW)
